title: Fail-loudly font refusal is unreachable: load_font_file returns rl.GetFontDefault() on every failure path, and IsFontValid(default) is true — the os.exit(2) guards can never fire, and no test covers them
detail: Every load_font_file failure path returns rl.GetFontDefault(); post-InitWindow IsFontValid(default) is true (texture unchecked, glyph data populated), so the app+harness refusal never fires. A missing/corrupt TTF silently renders the raylib default — the exact silent-fallback lie the round's blocker bar (c) requires impossible. The refusal path is also untested.
recommended_fix: Propagate load errors (or refuse when the result IS the default, e.g. texture.id == GetFontDefault().texture.id) so the guard can fire, and add a test/smoke leg that runs the loader with a missing asset and asserts refusal.

title: NOC mono pairing has zero automated coverage — the T2 capture path never draws draw_noc_overlay, so the font_mono swap, tabular MeasureTextEx, and NOC palette bumps are unpinned
evidence:
app/render/noc_overlay.odin:
noc_col :: proc(v: ^View, txt: string, size: i32, col: rl.Color, x_right: i32, y: i32) {
	w := i32(rl.MeasureTextEx(v.font_mono, strings_clone_cstr_noc(txt, v), f32(size), 1).x)
	draw_mono_c(v, txt, x_right - w, y, size, col)
}
--- harness/goldens.odin capture_frame (the whole T2 draw list) ---
	rl.BeginDrawing()
	rnd.draw_world(&rc.view, topo, bundles, flow, crisis, tick, {}, -1, -1, seed, interp_alpha)
	rnd.draw_forecast_panel(&rc.view, crisis, rc.view.catalogs, era, preview)
	rnd.draw_health_meter(&rc.view, health, rc.view.catalogs, health_on)
	banner_y: i32 = 10
	if health_on {
		banner_y = 10 + rnd.HEALTH_CARD_H + 6
	}
	rnd.draw_crisis_banner(&rc.view, crisis, rc.view.catalogs, era, banner_y)
	rl.EndDrawing()
detail: capture_frame draws world/forecast/health/banner only; no demo or golden renders the overlay (grep: draw_noc_overlay appears only in app/main.odin and the PP_DEBUG font_check verb). The briefing's rule-4 mono pairing is covered solely by gate-9 compile plus manual noc-e2e/overlay-check artifacts — a mono load/atlas regression ships silently.
recommended_fix: Add a T2 golden (or a capture in an existing demo) that renders draw_noc_overlay through capture_frame, so the mono surface is pixel-pinned like the rest of the HUD.

title: EndDrawing restructure moved the noc-e2e TakeScreenshot block BEFORE the flush (previously after) — the comment now claims it runs 'after the flush in both', contradicted by the code; no test pins the ordering
detail: The old code flushed (EndDrawing) then captured, per the tool's own documented precondition. The restructure captures first; rlReadScreenPixels glReadPixels without flushing the rlgl batch, so on GPU builds the D-key ON/OFF proof can read a pre-flush framebuffer. Nothing pins frame-end ordering.
recommended_fix: Restore EndDrawing before the noc-e2e capture block (gallery step after), correct the comment, and pin the ordering with a lint grep or scripted capture check.

title: PP_DEBUG tooling is compile-gate-only: gate 9 builds the debug binaries but nothing runs gallery_frame or the font-check verb, and the PP_SW_AUDIO branches are never compiled by any gate
evidence:
tools/ci-local.sh:
  "Core unit tests (the determinism + topology contracts)|mkdir -p bin && odin test core && for i in 1 2 3; do odin test app -out:bin/app-test || exit 1; done && odin test app/render -out:bin/render-test && odin test app/input -out:bin/input-test && odin test app/audio -out:bin/audio-test && odin test harness -out:bin/harness-test"
  "Game builds (app.bin compiles + links)|odin build app -out:app.bin"
  "PP_DEBUG overlay builds (compile gate)|odin build app -define:PP_DEBUG=true -out:app-debug.bin && odin build harness -define:PP_DEBUG=true -out:bin/harness-debug"
--- app/audio/audio.odin:162 ---
	when #config(PP_SW_AUDIO, false) {
(grep across *.sh/*.yml/*.odin: PP_SW_AUDIO appears only in audio.odin; PP_FONT_GALLERY appears in no script or workflow)
detail: The gallery stage machine, font-check verb, and run_demo_to_ms driver get at most a compile check; no script references PP_FONT_GALLERY, and no build defines PP_SW_AUDIO, so audio.odin SW branches are never compiled anywhere. Behavioural rot in the shipped tooling ships silently.
recommended_fix: Add a smoke leg that runs font-check and a short gallery capture on the SW shadow build with PP_SW_AUDIO=true, failing on non-zero exit; at minimum compile that configuration in a gate.
